warp.name: JoAi: Create Event Series

description.en: Create a recurring event series. The API generates the dated event occurrences from the rule (or leaves it to explicit dates only).

warp.bot: Use for recurring programmes (weekly classes, monthly nights, seasonal exhibitions). Give either a rule (weekly with interval, or nth-weekday) or only explicit dates. Occurrences are generated automatically; do not create rule dates by hand.

description.en: Series title used for every occurrence
IANA timezone of the series, e.g. Europe/Vienna
Season start (YYYY-MM-DD)
Season end (YYYY-MM-DD), optional
Length of each occurrence in minutes
Internal series: visible on the business page, hidden from the city calendar
Description copied into every occurrence
Team media IDs (JSON array) used as the series image

inputs.name: Rule

description.en: Recurrence rule object: {kind: weekly|nth-weekday, weekday: 1-7, time: HH:MM, interval?, nth?}

inputs.bot: weekday is ISO (1=Monday). weekly uses interval (1 or 2). nth-weekday uses nth (1-5). Omit the whole rule for explicit dates only.

warp.bot: Use this to create a deal, event, news, article, or job update for customers. Set startsAt/endsAt for time-limited offers, events, or job application windows. For jobs, put structured details in props: jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType (onsite|hybrid|remote), jobEmploymentType (full-time|part-time|contract|internship|temporary|volunteer|other, comma-separated), jobSalaryMin, jobSalaryMax, jobSalaryUnit (hour|day|week|month|year), jobSalaryCurrency, jobStartDate, jobApplyEmail.

inputs.bot: Optional props object (string values). For city-directory top news set {"top-news":"true"} on type=news. For jobs set jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType, jobEmploymentType, jobSalaryMin/Max/Unit/Currency, jobStartDate, and jobApplyEmail as needed.

en: Publish a limited-time offer for customers
Announce an upcoming event on a business profile
Post a longer article or local news to connected directories
Publish an open position for the team
de: Ein zeitlich begrenztes Angebot für Kunden veröffentlichen
Ein bevorstehendes Event im Betriebsprofil ankündigen
Einen längeren Artikel oder lokale News in verbundenen Verzeichnissen posten
Eine offene Stelle für das Team veröffentlichen

en.question: Can I publish deals, events, news, articles, and jobs?
en.answer: Yes. Use deal for offers, event for happenings, news for short announcements, article for longer posts, and job for open positions.

en.question: Can an update be scheduled?
en.answer: Yes. Add startsAt and endsAt to control when the update is active.

de.question: Kann ich Angebote, Events, News, Artikel und Jobs veröffentlichen?
de.answer: Ja. Nutze deal für Angebote, event für Veranstaltungen, news für kurze Ankündigungen, article für längere Beiträge und job für offene Stellen.

de.question: Kann ein Update geplant werden?
de.answer: Ja. Mit startsAt und endsAt steuerst du, wann das Update aktiv ist.

en: Change the dates of an event announcement
Correct the title or link of a news or article post
Update the application window of a job
de: Titel oder Link einer News oder eines Artikels korrigieren

en.question: Can I change the type of an update?
en.answer: Yes. Existing posts can be changed between deal, event, news, article, and job when needed.

en.question: Can I unpublish an update?
en.answer: Yes. Set its status to draft or archived depending on whether it should be hidden or retired.

de.question: Kann ich den Typ eines Updates ändern?
de.answer: Ja. Bestehende Beiträge können bei Bedarf zwischen deal, event, news, article und job wechseln.

de.question: Kann ich ein Update ausblenden?
de.answer: Ja. Setze den Status auf draft oder archived, je nachdem ob es versteckt oder endgültig erledigt ist.
